highlights.title: This Mac and your servers, side by side
highlights.text: Every place you use opens in its own window, all at once. Add a server once from the menu bar and it stays listed and signed in.

highlights.title: Ready-made teams
highlights.text: Create an Inbox, Sales or Coding team in one step: the bots, the team chat, starter skills and a routine. One Undo removes it all.

highlights.title: Work from Jira tickets
highlights.text: Connect Jira in Dev mode. A bot reads each ticket, writes a brief with its questions, and waits for your OK before it starts.

highlights.title: Watch live
highlights.text: A globe on a chat shows its bot is using the browser right now. Click it to watch the page.

highlights.title: Your bots on Telegram
highlights.text: Pair a Telegram chat to write to your bots and get their replies, questions and approvals on your phone.

highlights.title: Show it once
highlights.text: Show a bot a task once while kwant records the steps. Passwords and codes are never recorded. kwant turns it into a skill you review.

fixes: Install Claude Code, Codex or Grok in one click when it's missing.
A quieter working line above the message box on the phone.
The Dev mode switch no longer gets stuck in "settling".
After "Which is it?" in a forge form, focus lands on the first choice.
